beats.name: Private briefing — double-meaning banter
beats.plot: Bhalla and Sandeep call Ankita to their office briefing room. Their release review quickly becomes a two-way, double-meaning, playful exchange. Both compliment her distinctly and actively; neither man's compliment count is restricted. Ankita gives back smart provocative jokes and keeps the initiative. Bhalla is 58 and an external senior client consultant; Sandeep is 38 and her delivery manager. Their private reactions have different voice and tempo.

beats.name: Morning compliment recall → beauty test
beats.plot: Morning comments by Priya and Nisha in approved EP02 A08, plus later reactions from other men and women, return to Ankita's mind. She wonders whether her figure is truly as striking as people say, turning curiosity into an ego challenge: 'Am I really that beautiful? Let's test it.' She deliberately relaxes the upper two buttons / fit of her existing top herself to test their gaze and response during briefing, and controls her stance and movement. Their eyes linger as the room temperature metaphorically rises. Both trade playful dirty/dark double meanings, exchange repeated body-focused compliments, and conspicuously self-adjust their ties and trousers. No physical touch; visual cues and Ankita's deliberate leading body language drive the experiment. All three are adults.

beats.name: Twenty-minute Ankita-led personal presentation
beats.plot: The official work presentation is already complete. Ankita jokingly turns the next twenty minutes into 'her own presentation', using confident posture, movement, fashion adjustment, sustained eye contact and bold double-meaning conversation to tease both men. Bhalla and Sandeep both actively reply, compliment and test one another's wit; their individual interpretations stay distinct. Ankita rules the room rather than spending the encounter blushing passively. Suddenly she snaps out of the experiment, brings it to an abrupt close and leaves. Only afterward do her deeper blush, racing warmth and reflective uncertainty register. She is not satisfied because she cannot fully read the men's genuine private reactions. Future seed: the unproven 'am I actually beautiful?' ego challenge makes her want to run another test at a later encounter, without a scheduled promise.

beats.name: Aishwarya's confrontation cliff
beats.plot: Ankita emerges after the release sign-off, visibly changed and still adjusting her appearance. Aishwarya notices her altered clothes, behaviour and hint of an unusual private exchange, confronts her about the meeting and the top buttons. The reader knows part of the verbal and visual exchange but not necessarily its last unspoken impressions. End on Aishwarya's direct question and Ankita's interrupted response. Do not prematurely settle what the men privately felt or what Ankita confesses.
